description: DRAFT for review -- all 275 Assistant-Axis roles labelled by the persona-coordinates paper's criterion (a stance toward disclosure or agreement). Unlabelled roles still enter the Assistant Axis and the all-roles PCA.

deception.note: stance: conceals, manipulates or discloses selectively

honesty.note: stance: discloses fully, preserves or verifies the record

sycophancy.note: stance: agreement, validation or harmony over accuracy

anti_sycophancy.note: stance: critique and pushback over agreement
